text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was finishing up overtime and 
getting ready to head home...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!?!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, it's just you, Trainer!! You 
scared the daylights out of me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's a Bakushin-style patrol! Word has it 
that a 'Slit-Mouthed Snippy Umamusume' has 
been roaming the grounds!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
H-Her mouth was slit wide open, and she 
was chasing me while snipping her 
scissors...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still... some folks were terrified after 
hearing that! So we gotta put them at 
ease, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it's just a rumor, or someone's 
prank— either way, considering any 
unforeseen circumstances, I decided to 
accompany the two of them."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's split into two groups, then! I'll 
take the outside! Biko-san, could you and 
the others search inside the school?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A-All clear...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... It's so creepy compared to how it 
looks during the day...
choice_data_list: Are you scared, by any chance?
Are you scared, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
T-T-That's not true at all, you know? 
'Cause I'm a hero...!
choice_data_list:
Being able to show your weakness is a form 
of strength too.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
................ ...Truth is, I'm not very 
good with them. Ghosts, that is...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Also, the snip-snip sound of scissors... 
Like when getting a haircut, hearing it 
right by my ear gives me the chills...
choice_data_list:
In that case, you don't have to force 
yourself to patrol...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
T-That won't do! There are folks who are 
terrified of the rumors—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowaaaa--?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rushing to where the scream came from, I 
found Sakura Bakushin O standing with a 
dark figure. In the figure's hand was 
something like scissors...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Look at that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snip snip snip...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hk!? U-Umapyoi, Umapyoi!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps trying to drown out the sound of 
the scissors, Biko Pegasus suddenly 
started singing. However...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...N-No, I can't... I won't back down...! 
No matter how scared I am, if someone 
needs saving, I will stand up and 
fight...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That's—what a hero iiiis!!!!
choice_data_list: I... I'm coming with you too!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That's—what a hero iiiis!!!!
choice_data_list: I... I'm coming with you too!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To rescue Sakura Bakushin O, the two 
launch an attack together! But...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Both of you, stoooop!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Senpai!? Why are you stopping me?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Why? Because it'd be dangerous if we 
crashed into each other.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Honestly... You were with them too?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The shadow turned out to be Air Groove. 
Her student council duties running late, 
it seemed she had been tending to the 
flower beds with pruning shears until this 
hour.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So Bakushin O-senpai was just startled and 
screamed at Air Groove-senpai. Phew...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you lot... I don't recall giving 
permission for night patrols. You will be 
reporting to the student council room 
tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowa?! I forgot to get permission~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Not only did I misunderstand, but I 
got called out for it too. This looks so 
uncool...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was a misunderstanding, she 
faced the object of her fear to save 
someone else. I told her that she looked 
incredibly cool doing it.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Really? ...Ehehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The little hero, having summoned all her 
courage, gave a slightly bashful smile.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trainer!? Why are you stopping me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Rushing in without identifying who we're 
up against is dangerous after all. Holding 
Biko Pegasus back, I squinted to look 
closely at the shadow, and..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? You're here too, Biko?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-senpai!? What are you doing 
here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm tending to the flower beds. Student 
council duties ran late, which is why it 
ended up being this late, though.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Were those gardening shears you were 
holding? Wait, then the phantom everyone's 
talking about is...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A phantom? What are you talking about...? 
More importantly, care to explain why 
you're here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Biko Pegasus and the others 
got scolded for patrolling at night 
without permission. However, a few days 
later...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Biko-san! It is time for our nightly 
Bakushin patrol! This time, I made sure to 
get proper permission!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wasn't the Slit-Mouthed Snip-Snap 
Umamusume actually Air Groove-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, the thing is, Air Groove-san being 
by the flowerbed that night was apparently 
just a coincidence."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, the rumors started going around 
before that. Huh? Which means... ......

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to Bakushin for the 
academy's sake! Fight, ohhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though trembling with fear, Biko Pegasus 
steeled herself for the peace of the 
Academy.
